# Infinitary queue 11. Generated by Infinitary from one source; a newer Infinitary offers its update as a pull request, so change it there, not by hand.
# The Infinitary queue's batch template (docs/forge.md in Infinitary, "The
# shipped queue on GitLab"). Each job of the project's own
# .gitlab/infinitary-batch-checks.yml extends .infinitary-batch, so it checks
# out the batch, the default branch with each approved change merged in
# order, in place of its own checkout. The queue passes the batch as
# INFINITARY_BATCH, INFINITARY_BASE and INFINITARY_TREE.

.infinitary-batch:
  variables:
    GIT_DEPTH: "0"
  before_script:
    # INFINITARY_BATCH is a space-separated list of <number>:<version> words;
    # each change's version is fetched from its merge request.
    - for pair in $INFINITARY_BATCH; do git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin "+refs/merge-requests/${pair%%:*}/head:refs/infinitary/${pair%%:*}" || true; done
    - bash .gitlab/infinitary/compose.sh apply "$INFINITARY_BASE" "$INFINITARY_TREE" $INFINITARY_BATCH
